# Trigger pages

| File | Trigger | Fires when |
|---|---|---|
| `triggers/access-request-decision.md` | Access Request Decision | Fires after an access request is approved. |
| `triggers/access-request-dynamic-approval.md` | Access Request Dynamic Approval | Fires after an access request is submitted. |
| `triggers/access-request-submitted.md` | Access Request Submitted | Fires after an access request is submitted. |
| `triggers/account-aggregation-completed.md` | Account Aggregation Completed | Fires after an account aggregation completed, terminated, or failed. |
| `triggers/account-created.md` | Account Created | Fires after an account is created. |
| `triggers/account-deleted.md` | Account Deleted | Fires after an account is deleted. |
| `triggers/account-updated.md` | Account Updated | Fires after an account is updated. |
| `triggers/campaign-activated.md` | Campaign Activated | Triggered when a campaign is activated. |
| `triggers/campaign-ended.md` | Campaign Ended | Triggered when a campaign is ended. |
| `triggers/campaign-generated.md` | Campaign Generated | Triggered when a campaign finishes generating. |
| `triggers/certification-signed-off.md` | Certification Signed Off | Triggered when a certification is signed off by its reviewer. |
| `triggers/ciem-auto-include-scope-setting-changed.md` | CIEM Auto-Include Scope Setting Changed | Fires after a user enables or disables the Auto-Include Scope setting for a CIEM source. |
| `triggers/ciem-new-scope-detected.md` | CIEM New Scope Detected | Fires after a new AWS account, Azure subscription, or GCP project is detected by SailPoint CIEM. |
| `triggers/ciem-scope-selection-changed.md` | CIEM Scope Selection Changed | Fires after a user changes the scope selection for a CIEM source. |
| `triggers/form-submitted.md` | Form Submitted | Triggered when a form is submitted. |
| `triggers/identity-attribute-changed.md` | Identity Attributes Changed | Fires after one or more identity attributes changed. |
| `triggers/identity-created.md` | Identity Created | Fires after an identity is created. |
| `triggers/identity-deleted.md` | Identity Deleted | Fires after an identity is deleted. |
| `triggers/machine-identity-created.md` | Machine Identity Created | Fires after a machine identity is created. |
| `triggers/machine-identity-deleted.md` | Machine Identity Deleted | Fires after a machine identity is deleted. |
| `triggers/machine-identity-updated.md` | Machine Identity Updated | Fires after a machine identity is updated. |
| `triggers/native-change-account-created.md` | Native Change Account Created | Fires after Account Aggregations detects that a new account is created external to Identity Security Platform on sources |
| `triggers/native-change-account-deleted.md` | Native Change Account Deleted | Fires after Account Aggregations detects that an account is deleted external to Identity Security Platform on sources |
| `triggers/native-change-account-updated.md` | Native Change Account Updated | Fires after an account is updated outside of Identity Security Platform |
| `triggers/outlier-detected.md` | Outlier Detected | Fires after an identity was detected as an outlier. |
| `triggers/provisioning-completed.md` | Provisioning Completed | Fires after a provisioning action completed on a source. |
| `triggers/scheduled-search.md` | Scheduled Search | Fires after a scheduled search completes. |
| `triggers/source-created.md` | Source Created | Fires after a source is created. |
| `triggers/source-deleted.md` | Source Deleted | Fires after a source is deleted. |
| `triggers/source-updated.md` | Source Updated | Fires after a source is updated. |
| `triggers/va-cluster-status-change.md` | VA Cluster Status Change | Fires after the status of a VA cluster has changed. |
